levels.surface: أبو منصور أحمد بن إبراهيم الخوري
أبو القاسم عبد الله بن محمد الطائي

notes: Two bare kinship links (أبي, أبيه) and one collective (آبائه) are relation links (rule 7); none is named in the text.
Ali is the last link: the saying is his words to the man (أنه دعاه رجل فقال له علي). The unnamed رجل is in the saying, not the chain.
Correspondences (Khisal 204, Uyun 1) are other works and are not used.
